title: ledge config
description: Settings, passed with --config. Leave out a key to get its default.

screen.description: An index into the screens; 0 is the one with the menu bar. Default 0.

edge.description: The edge the bar runs along. Default bottom.

height.description: The bar's height in points. Default 110.

level.description: Which windows the bar stays above. top: everything, the Dock included. floating: other apps' windows, but not the Dock. normal: nothing; it's an ordinary window that others can cover. Default normal.

commands.description: Whether events may carry a `command` to run when their card is clicked. Anything running as you can send events, so this lets anything running as you put a command on your bar. Default false: an event with a command is refused.

theme.description: How the bar looks. default, the only one, follows the system's light or dark mode. See ledge-frontend's theme package.
